note: English-taught single-cycle (ciclo unico) programmes at Italian PUBLIC universities for A.Y. 2026/27, from official MUR DM 1005/2026 (IMAT Medicine/Dentistry/Veterinary) and official university pages (Pharmacy). Private universities in Tabella B (Cattolica, Humanitas, UniCamillus, San Raffaele, Campus Bio-Medico, Neuromed) are listed in MUR seats but omitted here as non-public. English Medicine/Dentistry/Veterinary remain on the national IMAT path; Italian-taught LM-41/46/42 use the Semestre Aperto/filter semester (excluded by D.Lgs. 71/2025 art. 8.3). Non-EU residents abroad compete only on the local ranking of the university where they completed Universitaly pre-enrolment.

imat.what: National admission test (prova di ammissione) for English-taught single-cycle Master's degrees in Medicine and Surgery (LM-41), Dentistry and Dental Prosthodontics (LM-46), and Veterinary Medicine (LM-42). One identical paper-based test at all Italian and foreign centres: 60 five-option MCQs in 100 minutes (4 reading/general knowledge, 5 logical reasoning, 23 biology, 15 chemistry, 13 physics & maths). Scoring: +1.5 correct, −0.4 wrong, 0 omitted (max 90). Prepared/managed by CINECA for MUR. At registration candidates irrevocably choose Medicine+Dentistry OR Veterinary (separate national rankings for EU/EU-equivalent).
imat.whoNeedsIt: All applicants to English-taught public (and participating private) LM-41 / LM-46 / LM-42 programmes: EU citizens, non-EU residents in Italy (art. 39/26 categories), and non-EU residents abroad. Non-EU abroad sit the same test but compete only for the reserved local seats of the university where they pre-enrolled on Universitaly. Minimum score: 20 points for EU/EU-equivalent; non-EU abroad need score > 0 (blank papers excluded). Pharmacy English programmes do NOT use IMAT.
imat.typicalTimeline: A.Y. 2026/27 (DM 1005/2026): Universitaly IMAT registration 26 Aug 2026–9 Sep 2026 15:00 GMT+2; test 29 Sep 2026 (Italian centres 13:30); anonymous scores by label code 8 Oct 2026; personal paper/score view 19 Oct 2026; national named rankings + first assignment 26 Oct 2026; then scrolling with 4-day enrolment windows. Separately, non-EU abroad must complete Universitaly pre-enrolment (university-specific deadlines, often earlier than IMAT registration) and study-visa applications by 30 Nov 2026 for A.Y. 2026/27.
imat.universitalyNote: IMAT registration is exclusively on Universitaly (Accesso programmato / English Medicine–Dentistry–Veterinary section). Candidates register, pay the participation fee as shown on the portal, declare university preferences (irrevocable after close), optional Annex-3 English certificates (tie-break only), and test venue. If sitting in Italy, the first Italian preference is the test centre. Non-EU residents abroad must ALSO complete Universitaly international pre-enrolment (https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri) at their chosen university before competing for that university’s non-EU quota; without pre-enrolment they cannot convert an IMAT score into a non-EU seat.
documents: Valid identity document (type, number, issuing authority, validity dates) declared on Universitaly registration
Personal/fiscal data required by Universitaly (name, birthplace/date, citizenship, residence, codice fiscale where applicable, email)
Upper secondary-school diploma or equivalent foreign qualification recognised as suitable (verified at enrolment / pre-enrolment; country-specific rules in Universitaly Allegato 1)
Universitaly pre-enrolment dossier for non-EU residents abroad (passport, school documents, translations/legalisations as required by the chosen university and Italian consulate)

Optional: recognised English language certificate (Annex 3 of DM 1005: Cambridge, IELTS, TOEFL, Trinity ISE, Pearson PTE, etc., B2+) — used for tie-breaking and often required by universities at enrolment
If claiming accommodations: disability/invalidity or DSA certification (legalised + sworn translation if issued abroad)
Study visa / residence permit process after assignment (visa applications for A.Y. 2026/27 by 30 Nov 2026 per Universitaly procedures)
